passive.name: More Sparkles!
passive.resolvedDescription: Zoe's next basic attack after casting a spell deals bonus magic damage.

Q.name: Paddle Star!
Q.resolvedDescription: Zoe fires a star that deals increasing damage the further it travels to the first enemy hit and surrounding enemies -- between 50/80/110/140/170 (+2-34 based on level) (+60% AP) to 125/200/275/350/425 (+5-85 based on level) (+150.00001% AP) magic damage. Zoe can Recast this Ability to redirect the missile to a new position near Zoe.

W.name: Spell Thief
W.resolvedDescription: Passive: Enemies drop spell shards when casting a Summoner Spell or using an Active Item. Specific minions also drop a spell shard when Zoe or a nearby ally kills them. Zoe can pick up this shard to cast that ability once. Passive: When Zoe casts this Ability or any Summoner Spell, she gains 30/40/50/60/70% Move Speed for 2/2.25/2.5/2.75/3 seconds and tosses 3 missiles at the target she Attacked most recently. These missiles deal 15/25/35/45/55 (+10% AP) magic damage each. Active: Cast the Ability from a spell shard Zoe has picked up.

E.name: Sleepy Trouble Bubble
E.resolvedDescription: Zoe dropkicks a bubble that deals 70/110/150/190/230 (+45% AP) magic damage, lingering as a trap if it hits nothing. The bubble's range is extended when flying over terrain. If either the bubble or trap hits an enemy champion she refreshes 16/19.5/23/26.5/30% of her cooldown. After a delay, the victim falls Asleep and have their Magic Resist reduced by 30% for 2 seconds. Attacks and Ability hits wake them up but deal double damage, up to 70/110/150/190/230 (+45% AP) true damage.

R.name: Portal Jump
R.resolvedDescription: Zoe teleports to a nearby position for 1 second. Afterwards, she teleports back. Zoe can use Abilities and Attack, but can't move during this time.
